method: Editorial language review of the sealed pending suffix 16..60 during the quote-v4 hardening pass. Each finding is bound to the exact sealed quotation digest it was raised against, records the reviewed correction that the source fragment supports, and is deliberately not applied: the depth-v2 release is sealed by the candidate, translation-ledger, audit and replacement digests, and the durable depth-v2 publication ledger binds every pending card payload hash, so applying it requires a new reviewed release identity plus a durable-state rebind rather than a silent edit.

entries.finding: The sealed Russian translation drops the copula dash and keeps the accusative complement: 'Покаяние не более заслуживающее спасение дело, чем вера. Это внутренний ответ.' The sentence is faithful to the source fragment but reads as a word-for-word calque; a native reader expects 'Покаяние заслуживает спасения не более, чем вера.' and 'Это внутренний отклик.'
entries.proposed_quotation_ru: Покаяние заслуживает спасения не более, чем вера. Это внутренний отклик.
entries.source_fragment: Repentance is no more a meritorious work than its counterpart, faith. It is an inward response.
entries.not_applied_because: The visible quotation is the sealed reviewed translation. Applying the correction changes the card payload hash, and the durable depth-v2 ledger binds that hash for every pending sequence, so the correction belongs to a new reviewed release identity that also re-binds the durable state.
